channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Fort Pierce honors 9/11 victims at Veterans Memorial Park ceremony
item.description: The Treasure Coast community gathered at Veterans Memorial Park in Fort Pierce for a 9/11 remembrance ceremony honoring the nearly 3,000 people killed and those impacted by the attacks. The ceremony included a wreath-laying for Fort Pierce native CeeCee Ross Lyles, a flight attendant aboard United Airlines Flight 93.

item.title: Fort Pierce native CeeCee Lyles honored at Flight 93 Memorial on 25th anniversary of 9/11
item.description: The family of CeeCee Ross Lyles, a Fort Pierce flight attendant who died on United Flight 93, gathered in Shanksville, Pennsylvania this week for the 25th anniversary ceremony at the Flight 93 Memorial.

item.title: Bomb threat forces evacuation at Indian River State College in Fort Pierce
item.description: Police evacuated three buildings at IRSC's Massey Campus on Friday morning after a staff member opened a threatening email. No explosives were found, and the FBI is now tracing the email's origin.

item.title: Treasure Coast traffic report: I-95 ramp closures and roadwork for Sept. 11-18
item.description: Drivers should expect multiple overnight I-95 ramp closures around Kanner Highway, High Meadow Avenue, Becker Road and Gatlin Boulevard, along with lane closures on major roads in Martin and St. Lucie counties.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Police Chief Leo Niemczyk shares 9/11 story after 25 years
item.description: Port St. Lucie Police Chief Leo Niemczyk, a former NYPD officer who worked at the World Trade Center site after the 9/11 attacks, is speaking publicly about his experience for the first time in decades.

item.title: Martin County marks 9/11 anniversary with Palm City bridge walk calling for unity
item.description: County leaders and residents crossed Veterans Memorial Bridge in Palm City on Friday carrying photographs of attack victims as speakers urged a return to the cooperation felt immediately after Sept. 11, 2001.

item.description: Port St. Lucie will honor victims, survivors and first responders of the Sept. 11 terrorist attacks at a remembrance ceremony Friday morning at the MIDFLORIDA Event Center.

item.description: Keith Anthony Morrone, 57, faces eight counts after St. Lucie County sheriff's detectives discovered improvised explosive devices and explosive-making materials while serving a risk protection order at his Fort Pierce home Thursday.

item.description: Vero Beach Regional Airport has completed its $3 million renovation with dual baggage claim gates allowing passengers to retrieve bags within 100 feet of aircraft arrival, along with covered walkways and a new courtyard.

item.description: Officers are working to identify a man found dead in the grass near a business on Okeechobee Road Wednesday morning. A witness told investigators the man was seen in the same spot the night before.

item.description: A bomb threat email that prompted Thursday's evacuation of Martin County High School has been traced to a hacked account at a Stuart residence, with investigators saying the attack appears linked to Russia and a broader pattern of swatting cases.

item.description: Ayleen Charles, a social studies teacher at Sunlight Christian Academy in Port St. Lucie, dedicates time each September to teaching students about the September 11 attacks through firsthand survivor stories and voicemails left by passengers.

item.description: The $57 million C-23 Canal project in Palm City has diverted nearly 5 billion gallons of water away from the Saint Lucie Estuary since entering operational testing in May, officials said at a ribbon-cutting Wednesday.

item.title: Fort Pierce man's shooting of charging dog confirmed justified after investigation
item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office confirmed Monday that a man acted in self-defense when he shot a dog Sunday in Fort Pierce's Indian River Estates after two dogs trapped his wife in her vehicle and one charged at him.

item.description: A 76-year-old man was ejected and hospitalized after his golf cart struck the back of a tractor on Tropical Way in Martin County's Tropical Farms community Saturday.

item.description: A 16-year-old suspect was arrested within 24 hours after detectives investigated an armed robbery in Fort Pierce where a victim was confronted with an AR-15-style rifle during an online meetup. The Fort Pierce Police Department credited fast detective work for the quick arrest.

item.title: Fellsmere woman, 75, wakes at 2:30 a.m. daily to feed stray cats, volunteers 60 hours a week at animal sanctuary
item.description: Linn Stewart of Indian River County rises before dawn each morning to feed a colony of stray cats, then spends her days volunteering at For the Love of Paws in Fellsmere. The sanctuary provides free pet food to food banks, veterans, and seniors while caring for animals left behind by elderly owners.
